messages:
Maya (AE): Acme wants a 6-month POC commit: 100 GPU-hours/month + ability to burst up to 3x for demos. Asking for 30% off commit rate. Need quick yes for SOW.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Quick clarifying q: 100 GPU-hours/month or 100 GPUs? Also model & avg seq len?
Maya (AE): 100 GPU-hours/month. Models: assistant + small reranker. Avg seq ~400, some evals spike to 3k-4k.
Renee (Sales Ops): 30% is outside standard discount bands. We can consider structured concession: smaller discount + formal burst limits. What's the expected ARR if they convert?
Maya (AE): ~$150k ARR if they go to production.
Dan (Finance): Need clear $ numbers. If list is $0.30/GPU-hour, monthly list = $30, 6mo = $180. 30% off seems small absolute — confirm units. Also need excess usage billing clause.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Burst will materially raise hours. 3x for two months could add 200-300 extra hours.
Kai (SRE): Ops note: 2x burst we can support without changes. 3x requires warm pool reservation and an ops carveout. Warm pool costs ~ $0.04/GPU-hour.
Renee (Sales Ops): Proposal: approve 20% discount on 6mo commit + burst policy: 2x immediate; 3x allowed first 30 days capped at 400 extra hours; further 3x needs 72h notice and ops signoff.
Maya (AE): Customer prefers 25% and 3x first 30 days. Can we push to 22-25%?
Dan (Finance): We can approve up to 22% with manager signoff if we add warm-pool fee and excess billing at on-demand rates in SOW.
dealbot: Created ticket DEAL-6210 for Acme POC commit (6mo, 100 GPU-hrs/mo, proposed 22% discount, burst policy). <https://redwood.atlassian.example/DEAL-6210>
Renee (Sales Ops): I'll draft SOW language with burst cap, warm-pool fee, and 72h notice clause. Sending to legal & finance for signoff.
Maya (AE): Thanks team — I'll relay to Acme and aim to close POC acceptance today.
